mapper.sql: r.del_flag = '0' and r.room_id = #{roomId} and r.room_code like concat('%', #{roomCode}, '%') and r.room_name like concat('%', #{roomName}, '%')
cross join ( select ifnull(sum(time_to_sec(timediff(end_time, start_time)) / 60), 0) as available_minutes from space_time_period where status = '0' ) tp
mapper.select:
select count(case when sr.del_flag = '0' then sri.item_id end) as reservation_count, ifnull(sum(case when sr.del_flag = '0' and sri.item_status in ('2', '6') then 1 else 0 end), 0) as success_count, ifnull(sum(case when sr.del_flag = '0' and sri.item_status = '3' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as reject_count, ifnull(sum(case when sr.del_flag = '0' and sri.item_status in ('1', '4') then 1 else 0 end), 0) as pending_count, count(distinct r.room_id) as room_count, ifnull(round( sum(case when sr.del_flag = '0' and sri.item_status in ('2', '6') then time_to_sec(timediff(sri.end_time, sri.start_time)) / 60 else 0 end) / nullif(count(distinct r.room_id) * (datediff(#{endDate}, #{startDate}) + 1) * max(tp.available_minutes), 0) * 100, 2 ), 0) as occupancy_rate from space_room r
left join space_reservation_item sri on left join space_reservation sr on sr.reservation_id = sri.reservation_id and sr.del_flag = '0' where

select r.room_code, r.room_name, count(case when sr.del_flag = '0' then sri.item_id end) as reservation_count, ifnull(sum(case when sr.del_flag = '0' and sri.item_status in ('2', '6') then 1 else 0 end), 0) as success_count, ifnull(sum(case when sr.del_flag = '0' and sri.item_status = '3' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as reject_count, ifnull(round(sum(case when sr.del_flag = '0' and sri.item_status in ('2', '6') then time_to_sec(timediff(sri.end_time, sri.start_time)) / 60 else 0 end) / 60, 2), 0) as occupied_hours, ifnull(round( sum(case when sr.del_flag = '0' and sri.item_status in ('2', '6') then time_to_sec(timediff(sri.end_time, sri.start_time)) / 60 else 0 end) / nullif((datediff(#{endDate}, #{startDate}) + 1) * max(tp.available_minutes), 0) * 100, 2 ), 0) as occupancy_rate from space_room r
left join space_reservation_item sri on left join space_reservation sr on sr.reservation_id = sri.reservation_id and sr.del_flag = '0' where group by r.room_id, r.room_code, r.room_name order by reservation_count desc, occupancy_rate desc

select date_format(sri.booking_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as stat_date, count(sri.item_id) as reservation_count, ifnull(sum(case when sri.item_status in ('2', '6') then 1 else 0 end), 0) as success_count, ifnull(sum(case when sri.item_status = '3' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as reject_count from space_reservation_item sri left join space_reservation sr on sr.reservation_id = sri.reservation_id left join space_room r on r.room_id = sri.room_id where sr.del_flag = '0' and and sri.booking_date >= #{startDate} and sri.booking_date <= #{endDate} group by sri.booking_date order by sri.booking_date asc
